headline.en: UNI pops +7.4% through the $5.96 DAO anchor, but 7d flat and net inflation say this is a squeeze, not a regime change.
headline.zh: UNI 单日拉升 7.4% 突破 DAO 心理锚点 $5.96，但 7 日仅涨 0.79% 且仍处净通胀，这是逼空而非趋势转折。

keyChanges.en: Price reclaimed $5.96 treasury-burn anchor, closing at $6.395 (+7.42% 24h) — yet 7d change is only +0.79%, meaning the move is a one-session event on thin $25.26M volume.
keyChanges.zh: 价格重新站上 $5.96 国库回购锚点，收于 $6.395（24h +7.42%），但 7 日仅 +0.79%，说明是单日事件，且成交量仅 $25.26M，动能薄弱。

keyChanges.en: Burn/emission math still broken: $41.93M annualized buyback burns 6.56M UNI vs 20M UNI emission — net +1.51%/yr dilution. Every rally makes the burn buy fewer tokens, worsening the ratio.
keyChanges.zh: 回购/增发数学仍未打平：年化 $41.93M buyback 仅销毁 6.56M UNI，对应 20M UNI 增发，净通胀 +1.51%/年。价格越高，回购能买回的 UNI 越少，比例反而恶化。

keyChanges.en: Governance surface widening: two live Temp Checks — v4 Protocol Fees activation and Robinhood Chain fee expansion — could materially lift the $246.67M annualized revenue base if they advance.
keyChanges.zh: 治理面正在扩张：两个活跃 Temp Check（v4 协议费启用、Robinhood Chain 费用扩展）若推进，可实质性抬高当前 $246.67M 年化收入基数。

contrarianObservation.en: If both v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain Temp Checks pass, annualized revenue could step up 30-50% without any price move, flipping UNI net-deflationary at spot. The market is pricing zero probability of this — the tape treats governance as noise, which is exactly when governance matters.
contrarianObservation.zh: 若 v4 协议费与 Robinhood Chain 两个 Temp Check 均通过，年化收入可无需价格上涨即阶跃增长 30-50%，在当前 spot 直接翻转为净通缩。市场目前对此定价为零——盘面把治理当噪音，而这正是治理最值钱的时刻。

watchNext.en: [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees — outcome and quantified revenue delta. This is the single highest-impact governance item on the board.
watchNext.zh: [Temp Check] Activate v4 Protocol Fees 的投票结果与收入增量测算——这是当前治理面影响最大的单项议案。

watchNext.en: Binance UNIUSDT funding — currently 0.00% with L/S 1.91. If funding turns positive while price holds $6+, retail is chasing and this bounce fades into supply.
watchNext.zh: Binance UNIUSDT funding rate——目前 0.00%，账户多空比 1.91。若价格站稳 $6+ 时资费转正，即散户追多，此波反弹将被抛压吞噬。

watchNext.en: Any re-emergence of the real-yield RFC (buyback → stakers). Silent since last cycle; its return is the only clean catalyst to reprice UNI on DCF rather than PE-multiple.
watchNext.zh: real-yield RFC（buyback 分给 stakers）是否重启讨论。上一轮之后沉寂，其回归是让 UNI 从 PE 估值切换到 DCF 估值的唯一干净催化剂。

fullReasoning.en: Today's tape is loud but hollow. A +7.42% day that leaves the 7d return at +0.79% is a squeeze, not accumulation, and $25.26M spot volume on a $3.98B cap is not the footprint of real bid. Price is now $0.44 above the $5.96 DAO burn anchor, meaning anyone who agreed with the treasury's own fair-value mark is currently in profit and has an incentive to distribute. The structural problem hasn't moved: at $6.395, the 17%-of-revenue buyback consumes 6.56M UNI while the protocol emits 20M — UNI is still diluting holders by 1.51% per year, and higher price makes the buyback less efficient, not more. Derivatives confirm the caution: funding is flat at 0.00% with L/S at 1.91, meaning retail accounts lean long but leverage hasn't paid up — the classic setup for a fade. The one genuine constructive is the governance surface: v4 Protocol Fees and Robinhood Chain fee expansion are both in Temp Check, and either advancing would raise the revenue base that drives the burn. But nothing has passed, no real-yield RFC is live, and until the emission/burn ratio inverts, rallies above $6 are supply zones. Bearish, medium confidence, 1-4 week horizon.
fullReasoning.zh: 今日盘面响亮但空心。单日 +7.42% 却让 7 日回报仅 +0.79%，这是逼空而非吸筹；$3.98B 市值下 $25.26M 的现货成交量根本不是真实买盘足迹。价格现比 $5.96 国库回购锚点高出 $0.44，认同 DAO 自身公允价值标记的持有者目前均已获利，具备派发动机。结构性问题毫无改善：$6.395 价位下，17% 收入 buyback 仅能销毁 6.56M UNI，而协议增发 20M——UNI 仍以 1.51%/年稀释持有人，且价格越高，回购效率越低而非越高。衍生品数据印证谨慎：funding rate 平于 0.00%，账户多空比 1.91，说明散户偏多但杠杆资金尚未买单，经典的反弹被吞设置。唯一真正的建设性因素在治理面：v4 Protocol Fees 与 Robinhood Chain 费用扩展两项 Temp Check 若推进，可抬升驱动销毁的收入基数。但目前尚无议案落地，也无 real-yield RFC 活跃；在增发/销毁比率翻转之前，$6 以上的反弹都是供给区。看空，中等置信度，1-4 周视角。
